+

workouts.title: Strict Press
workouts.description:
Strict Press
Take 10:00 to build to a 6RM @ RPE 9
+
+
Rest 2-3 Minutes.
1 Set of Max Reps @ 90% of 6RM

NOTES:
- Aim to hit a very tough six reps while maintaining near-perfect form.
- On the max reps set, make sure that you are not bouncing the bar off of your collar bones to get extra reps. Reps from a static start will build more strength.

workouts.title: ERG BIKE INTERVALS.
workouts.description:
ERG BIKE INTERVALS.
WARM-UP.
3:00 @ Easy Spin
+
2 Sets:
1:00 @ Fast
1:00 @ Slow
No Rest Between Sets. ( decide on what the fast and the slow pace will be for today )
+
Rest as needed.
MAIN SET.
5 Sets:
1:00 @ Fast @RPE 9-10
2:00 @ Moderate @RPE 8
2:00 @ Slow @RPE 7
Rest :30 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- The focus of this workout is not the first fast minute in each set. Focus on holding as close to the "easier" paces as possible. This will improve your discipline, control, and ability to recover in workouts.
- If you are using a PM5 monitor, use this link to set your monitor and track your results on 
ErgData:
https://workout.ergdata.com/shared/drff5bvf

workouts.title: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
workouts.description:
Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
3 Sets:
:30 Max Reps Bench ** // RPE 7
Rest 1:30 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Perform these with a @ 2020 tempo (i.e. :02 down, no pause at the bottom, :02 up, no pause at the top).
- Don't game the :30, perform controlled reps for the entire thirty seconds.
- Use a load that feels like an RPE 7.

workouts.title: Strict Pull-Up
workouts.description:
Strict Pull-Up

OPTION A:
3 Sets of Max Reps (Cap @ 12 Reps)
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- This option is for those who either have strict pull-ups but are not ready to load them, or for people who do not have strict pull-ups and will need to use a band.
- Use a band if you will get less than five reps on any given set.
- Leave one rep in the tank on each set.
- If you are using bands, use as few bands as possible, and aim for at least eight reps on each set
.
OPTION B.
Weighted Strict Pull-Up
Build to a 5-rep max weighted pull-up.

NOTES:
- Use a challenging load that allows you to perform five explosive reps.
